title: The data economy of public proteomics over thirteen years of PRIDE
description: Code, frozen source metadata, extraction observations, analytical results, figures and author-review manuscript for 36,249 PRIDE deposits released during 2013–2025. The mention model uses 2,000 contributor-group bootstrap draws. The offline pipeline reconstructs the analyses, 19 numbered figures at 600 dpi and 22 supplementary tables. Code is licensed under MIT; author-created data, text and figures are CC BY 4.0. Third-party rights are retained, and the BioRender overview requires a separately verified publication export/license. Software-version and ZIP-contained-header observations remain archived extraction inputs; original response bytes are unavailable. See REPRODUCIBILITY.md for the validation scope and limitations. This is a pre-submission package awaiting author approval.
